summary.text: Travis Jack Stevens is an unaffiliated write-in candidate. He is a nurse and massage therapist who lives near Rehoboth Beach and describes his campaign as people-funded, built around daily public letters to Delaware voters.

paragraphs.text: According to his Ballotpedia survey response, he was born in Hagerstown, Maryland, to a working-class family.

Worked for years as a nurse, including four years as a travel ICU nurse (three at David Grant Medical Center, a Department of Defense hospital on Travis Air Force Base), and worked in a COVID unit in Delaware during the pandemic, per his survey response.
Currently works as a massage therapist, lives near Rehoboth Beach, and sings with the CAMP Rehoboth Chorus, per his survey response.
Publishes a series of daily public letters to Delaware voters at travisjackstevens.com covering healthcare, foreign policy, housing, and democratic reform.
